descriptionChirho: Qal participle of שָׁתַן meaning 'one who urinates,' used idiomatically in the phrase 'one who urinates against a wall' to denote any male. All clusters show identical meaning: English 'one urinating/one who urinates,' Spanish 'quien orina/orinando,' Hindi 'पेशाब करनेवाला/मश्तीन,' Arabic 'بائِلاً' (one urinating) in both clusters, Korean '오줌 누는 자' (one who urinates), Swahili 'anayekojoa/mwanaume yeyote' (one who urinates/any male). The single-occurrence cluster is just a spelling variant of the same Qal participle.
